# package ptcp

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/ptcp"
```

Package ptcp encodes and decodes the delay frames of the Precision Transparent Clock Protocol (PTCP, IEC 61158-6-10): DelayReq and the delay responses with which neighbors measure the line delay of a link. The layouts are those of Wireshark's PTCP dissector (docs/research/EVIDENCE-MRP-PTCP-MGMT.md, B). It is a codec only: a general-purpose OS has no hardware timestamps, so go-profinet measures no line delay and reports it as "not measured", as p-net does; PTCP synchronization (IRT) is out of scope.

## Constants

```go
const (
	FrameIDDelayReq   uint16 = 0xFF40
	FrameIDDelayRes   uint16 = 0xFF41
	FrameIDDelayFuRes uint16 = 0xFF42
	FrameIDDelayFu    uint16 = 0xFF43
)
```

FrameIDs of the delay frames (in the PROFINET RT frame, EtherType 0x8892). Wireshark names 0xFF41 DelayRes, 0xFF42 DelayFuRes and 0xFF43 the response's follow-up; which response comes with a follow-up is not verified.

```go
const HeaderLen = 20
```

HeaderLen is the length of a delay PDU's header after the FrameID.

## Functions

### func IsDelay

```go
func IsDelay(frameID uint16) bool
```

IsDelay reports whether a FrameID is in the delay range 0xFF40-0xFF5F.

## Types

### type Delay

```go
type Delay struct {
	FrameID    uint16
	SequenceID uint16
	// Delay is Delay1ns (nanoseconds; in a follow-up the responder's
	// delay).
	Delay uint32
	// PortMAC is DelayParameter's PortMACAddress when HasPortMAC.
	PortMAC    ethernet.MAC
	HasPortMAC bool
	// RxDelay and TxDelay are PortParameter's T2PortRxDelay and
	// T3PortTxDelay (ns) when HasPortParameter.
	RxDelay, TxDelay uint32
	HasPortParameter bool
	// T2TimeStamp is PortTime's T2TimeStamp (ns) when HasPortTime.
	T2TimeStamp uint32
	HasPortTime bool
}
```

Delay is a delay PDU: the request, a response or a follow-up.

#### func Decode

```go
func Decode(b []byte) (Delay, error)
```

Decode decodes a delay PDU, FrameID first. Unknown TLVs are skipped.

func (d *Delay) AppendTo(b []byte) []byte
